# Generational: What Echoes Forward

The question of legacy is often posed as a question about genetics: What will you pass on to your children, and to their children, in the form of biological inheritance? The question of genetic contribution is real—children inherit traits from parents, and those traits shape the lives that those children go on to live. Bob's children carried his genes, his tendencies, his predispositions toward certain ways of being in the world.
